correctness.rationale: For E_n with e_i²=f_i and all other products zero, any endomorphism has block P=[A 0; C A^[2]] with A row-sparse (at most one nonzero per row). P²=P forces each nonzero row of A to point to a root unit diagonal row. Choosing r roots, each remaining row has 1+r(q-1) options. A^[2] shares rank r and C A+A^[2] C=C has two free off-diagonal blocks dimension 2r(n-r), giving N_{n,r}=binom(n,r)(1+r(q-1))^{n-r}q^{2r(n-r)} and image rank 2r of type E_r. Uniform Stirling expansion for r=n/2+O(log n), combined with second-difference log-concavity <= -4log q and a summable tail comparison, gives total variation to moving lattice Gaussian centered mu_n=n/2+(1-log((q-1)n/2))/(4log q), and sharp K_n theta asymptotic for fixed q. Independently enumerated n=2,q=2 map blocks and compared q=3 weights with Gaussian at n=100,300,1000. No fixed-center convergence or growing-q uniformity claimed.
